limitations: Exact source identity comparison is not absolute contamination proof.
Web landing-page identities can miss source ancestry; no web repo metadata is available.
Package Manager Credits disclose copied code but link some contributor accounts rather than exact repositories. Declared repository candidates require full provenance resolution.

MacPass remains a conditional reserve and is excluded from formal sufficiency here.
